description: Picks the cheapest sizes that fit a workload, across clouds and cities, from what can be deployed now. Describe the workload (e.g. "Minecraft for 12 players", "Llama 3.1 8B with Ollama", "WireGuard VPN for 5 people") and add numbers when known. Returns fitting options with hourly and monthly price, the sizing basis, and for cheaper sizes that do not fit, one line why. Sizing comes from NoctHost's published guides. Does not create anything.

max_hourly_usd.description: Budget per server per hour, USD.

model_size_b.description: LLM size in billions of parameters, e.g. 8 for an 8B model (4-bit quantized).

monthly_traffic_gb.description: Expected outbound traffic per month, GB.

need_windows.description: Windows Server instead of Linux (its own price, at least 4 GB RAM).

users.description: Players, VPN users, streams or services, depending on the workload.

workload.description: What the server is for, in plain words.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a server size
